title: Review competitor collaboration and information exchange
summary: A counsel-reviewed proceed, modify or decline decision with approved information boundaries and monitored implementation.
outcomes: A counsel-reviewed proceed, modify or decline decision with approved information boundaries and monitored implementation.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before collaboration, information exchange or agreements involving actual or potential competitors, and when the scope changes.

parts.title: Describe the collaboration and information flows
parts.guidance: Record the participants, markets, purpose, proposed agreement, meetings and information to be exchanged. Identify pricing, customers, output, bids and other sensitive subjects for counsel; use private materials without contacting competitors or circulating new information.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Obtain competition-law assessment before exchange
parts.guidance: Qualified competition counsel assesses the actual parties, markets, restrictions and applicable jurisdictional rules. Escalate sensitive exchanges and proposed coordination before participation; this guide supplies no exemption, safe-harbor threshold or automatic clearance.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Prepare the counsel-directed controls
parts.guidance: Prepare the proposed agenda, permitted information categories, access restrictions and recordkeeping under counsel instructions. Identify prohibited topics and stop or escalation routes; any clean-team arrangement needs counsel approval for this specific matter.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Approve, modify or decline the proposal
parts.guidance: The accountable legal and business owners record the counsel-reviewed decision and precise conditions. If declined, skip agreement and exchange. A commercial manager or agent cannot replace competition review with a general confidentiality agreement.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Approve, modify or decline the proposal

parts.title: Implement only the approved collaboration
parts.guidance: Authorized participants use the approved agreement, meeting agenda and information controls. Keep a record of recipients and shared materials, stop an exchange that crosses its boundaries, and refer changes or unexpected sensitive discussions to counsel.
parts.when: Only when the counsel-reviewed decision approves this collaboration.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Review compliance and retain the decision trail
parts.guidance: Reconcile actual participants, shared information and activities against the approved limits. Assign breaches and changes to counsel, retain decision and meeting records, and close declined proposals without executing an agreement or exchanging the proposed information.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.
